title: Joint faithfulness of finite quotient evaluations after integral reduction
statement:
theorem integralSystemReduction_map_ext
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    {A B : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X}
    (p q : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map p) =
        (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map q)) :
    (integralSystemReduction l E X).map p =
      (integralSystemReduction l E X).map q

source.place: the levelwise extensionality step for the coherent coefficient-system reduction.

proof.text: A morphism in the derived category of transition-compatible coefficient systems is represented levelwise on the sequence site. Derived localization is componentwise, so equality at every coefficient level reflects equality of the whole system morphism.
